note: A pre-training recoverability score for CAM-style supervision would be a real planning tool; the mutual-information estimate is model-dependent (own note) and WSSS enthusiasm has cooled, which cuts venue appetite.

Per-error-type inheritance coefficients give pseudo-labeling a computable genetics and a predictable self-training ceiling; the error-taxonomy subjectivity is manageable with automatic taxonomies plus human validation.

Demystifying consistency regularization via coverage-matched factorial design is good mechanistic science; the coverage-matching control (own note) is genuinely subtle and is where reviewers will attack.

'Objects for free are inherited from photographic framing, not discovered' is a foundational causal question about SSL; scene-centric SSL studies exist but not the controlled de-object-centrification intervention. Scale ceiling on reruns is the honest risk.

Matching-protocol sensitivity is a real circularity in unsupervised segmentation evaluation; the matching-free criteria need their own validation (own note), which the human-usefulness anchor supplies.
Motion-as-teacher has a long lineage (motion segmentation to static transfer); the class-resolved recovery accounting with the mobile-teaches-static transfer leg is the specific open slice.

The depth-semantic disagreement atlas as a predictive failure map for depth-based self-supervision is tidy and cheap; the finding is a characterization whose value depends on how big the disagreement zones turn out to be.
Supervision-portfolio theory with measured interaction terms is directly usable by annotation planners; the full factorial training grid is a heavy compute bill for an economics table.

Label-free collapse precursors (entropy fall + spatial autocorrelation rise) would make self-training preventable rather than post-mortem; the multi-modal collapse taxonomy (own note) is the required groundwork.
The qualitative rich-get-richer bias is known (own KNOWN note) and threshold-correction heuristics exist; the fitted forecast-validated dynamic is the delta, respectable but incremental.

Temporal-correspondence positives for dense contrastive pretraining are published repeatedly (space-time correspondence SSL, video-frame-similarity pretraining, dense tracking-based positives); matched-compute bookkeeping does not revive it.

An information ceiling on what text can teach about boundaries is a deep division-of-labor claim; ceiling estimation from finite checkpoint ladders is extrapolation (own note) and the claim invites metaphysical objections. Worth one careful shot.
Metadata conditioning is a cheap free-lunch audit; the leakage-vs-real-prior control (cross-dataset test, own note) is the entire scientific content - without it this is a +1 mIoU engineering note.

Itemized error anatomy of SAM-pipeline labels, with inheritance measurement, is the constructive companion to 0206's fingerprint forensics; timely before the ecosystem finishes training a generation on such labels.
Instance-across-context pairs occupy a genuinely empty niche between category-level and augmentation-level supervision; retrieval precision gating determines whether the signal survives mining noise.

A measurable 'shape half-life' of iterated self-training, with the anchor-subset antidote, quantifies a decay everyone suspects; the noise-removal-vs-blob-drift confound is neatly handled by shape-known synthetic insets.
'Shape, not semantics, is the transferable currency' with adversarial donor pairs (snake vs lizard) is a cute testable inversion; class-set design to unconfound shape from context is fiddly.

Foundation-regime re-baselining that could obsolete a subfield's methodology; pre-registration and authors'-code discipline (own note) is what separates a service to the field from a flame war. High leverage per GPU.

Two-regime noise taxonomy with a diagnose-then-treat framework is useful; segmentation label-noise studies exist, so the composition estimator for real datasets (own note: the load-bearing deliverable) must be the centerpiece.

A transferable 'granularity dial' would solve a real usability problem of unsupervised discovery; the risk that granularity is irreducibly multi-modal per image (own note) is substantial and would reduce the dial to a distribution knob.

A tracker-independent propagation-quality law that prices video weak supervision before labeling is a solid planning instrument; domain transfer of the law (sports vs surgery) is the open question it must answer itself.

Design files as a mask corpus with professional boundary quality and different economics is the most original data idea in the batch; licensing and harvesting engineering are real but characterizable. Lit-attacked below.
Audio-visual segmentation benchmarks exist; the supervision-LIMITS taxonomy and the hitchhiking pathway are the fresh parts - a negative-space study of a positive-results literature.

Support-consistency as an orthogonal pseudo-label filter is physically grounded and complements confidence filtering by construction; the false-flag taxonomy on airborne/occluded-support objects will decide its precision claim.

Label-free ranking with self-detected validity conditions is strong; the built-in punchline (lineage overlap is becoming universal, defeating consensus) may be the more important finding and connects to C12's monoculture agenda.
